Container.Name: novacortex-web

Branch.TagDescription: Rolling tag — always the newest published release

Container.Overview:
Web UI for NovaCortex — self-hosted, MCP-native long-term memory for AI agents.
Part 5 of a 5-container stack, and the only one you open in a browser. It is a thin front end: it needs a running NovaCortex API, which in turn needs SurrealDB, Qdrant and Redis.
Two supported ways to install, both ending up with the same five container names:
-- Path A: the five NovaCortex templates from Community Apps, in this order --
0. Create the shared network once, from an Unraid terminal: docker network create novacortex Container-name DNS only works on a user-defined network, and that is how these containers find each other. 1. novacortex-redis 2. novacortex-surrealdb 3. novacortex-qdrant 4. novacortex-api 5. novacortex-web (this template)
Point API URL below at your API container. Leave the default if it runs on this server as novacortex-api; use http://SERVER-IP:3001 if the API lives on another host.
-- Path B: the whole stack in one click, with the Docker Compose Manager plugin --
1. Install the "Docker Compose Manager" plugin from Community Apps. 2. Add a new project named "novacortex". Compose Manager creates /boot/config/plugins/compose.manager/projects/novacortex/ 3. Put docker-compose.unraid.yml from the repository in that folder as docker-compose.yml: curl -fsSL -o docker-compose.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Nova-Cognitive-Systems/novacortex/main/docker-compose.unraid.yml 4. Create a .env next to it with scripts/gen-env.sh --unraid, which writes strong random secrets and APPDATA=/mnt/user/appdata/novacortex. Add --local-ai for a fully offline install, then start the stack with the "local-ai" profile. .env.unraid.example documents every value. Keep APPDATA an absolute path on the array. Compose Manager stores its projects on the FAT32 boot flash, which has no Unix ownership, so a relative data root leaves Redis unable to take ownership of its own directory and restart-looping as unhealthy. 5. Check the ports in .env are free before starting. 3000 is a popular default on Unraid (Grafana, Homepage, Overseerr, ...), so it is often already taken. If "ss -ltnp | grep -E ':(3000|3001)'" shows something listening, set e.g. WEB_PORT=3100. 6. Compose Up. Then read the one-time bootstrap code with "docker logs novacortex-api 2>&1 | grep -A1 'Bootstrap code'" and paste it on the login page to mint your admin token.
Default ports: Web UI 3000, API 3001 — set here in the template on path A, or via WEB_PORT / API_PORT in the .env on path B. Data lives under /mnt/user/appdata/novacortex either way, so it survives docker.img rebuilds and is covered by Unraid appdata backups.
Container.Description:
NovaCortex gives AI agents a persistent, queryable memory that lives on your own hardware. Typed memories (episodic, semantic, procedural, working) with salience and decay, semantic vector search over Qdrant, a typed relation graph, a document knowledge base, and per-agent namespaces. Agents connect over MCP (Claude, Cursor, Claude Code), the REST API, the CLI or the TypeScript/Python SDKs. Memory can be exported and re-imported as portable JSON, MessagePack or AES-256-GCM-encrypted archives, so there is no lock-in.
Embeddings are optional and off by default. Point the API at an Ollama sidecar to keep every byte of memory text on this server, or at OpenAI (or any OpenAI-compatible endpoint) if you prefer hosted embeddings. Apache-2.0; the free tier needs no key and no account.
This container serves the Web UI on port 3000 and proxies browser calls to the API over the Docker network via API_INTERNAL_URL, so the API does not need to be published publicly.
Container.Requires: A user-defined Docker network named "novacortex" (docker network create novacortex) and a reachable NovaCortex API — this template does not install one. Use the novacortex-api template, or the Docker Compose Manager stack described in the overview. Web UI and API must run the same NovaCortex version.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the NovaCortex Web UI. 3000 is a popular default on Unraid (Grafana, Homepage, Overseerr, ...) — if it is already taken, change this to e.g. 3100. The WebUI link above follows whatever you set here; the container keeps listening on 3000 internally.

Config.Name: API URL
Config.Description: Where the Web UI reaches the NovaCortex API. Use http://novacortex-api:3001 when both containers share a Docker network, or http://SERVER-IP:3001 otherwise.
